stem: According to the selections, the Leaning Tower of Pisa is different from the Cutty Sark because —

options.label: F
options.text: the Leaning Tower of Pisa has been flawed since its construction, but the Cutty Sark functioned well for many years

options.label: G
options.text: the Leaning Tower of Pisa has achieved fame in recent years, but the Cutty Sark was famous from the time it was built

options.label: H
options.text: the work on the Leaning Tower of Pisa is finished, but the work on the Cutty Sark is ongoing

options.label: J
options.text: the Leaning Tower of Pisa can no longer be used as a bell tower, but the Cutty Sark can still be used for some of its original purposes
